default_episode.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((pixels (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (!= (at g r c) 0))
                            (list r c (at g r c)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let loop
                           ((ps pixels) (colors (list)))
                           (cond
                             ((null? ps) (cond
                                 ((null? colors) 0)
                                 ((null? (cdr colors)) (first colors))
                                 (else 2)))
                             (else (let* ((p (car ps))
                                          (pr (first p))
                                          (pc (second p))
                                          (pcol (third p)))
                                     (if (or (= r pr) (= c pc))
                                         (if (member pcol colors)
                                             (loop (cdr ps) colors)
                                             (loop (cdr ps) (cons pcol colors)))
                                         (loop (cdr ps) colors)))))))))))
default_episode.rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ([h (rows g)] [w (cols g)]
         [pixels (for*/list ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range w)]
                   #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0))
                     (not (and (or (= r 0) (= r (- h 1)))
                               (or (= c 0) (= c (- w 1)))))))
                   (list r c (at g r c)))])
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
      (let ([colors (remove-duplicates
              (for/list ([p (in-list pixels)]
                         #:when (or (= r (first p)) (= c (second p))))
                (third p)))])
        (cond [(empty? colors) 0] [(= (length colors) 1) (first colors)] [else 2])))))))
